name: flappy-claude
description: Flappy Bird with Clawd, the Claude Code mascot, in a pane, terminal and desktop. Space, click, or slap your MacBook (with ClaudeWhip) to flap.

pauseWhip.title: Pause ClaudeWhip while the game is open
pauseWhip.description: With ClaudeWhip installed, a slap then only flaps Clawd instead of also whipping Claude.

slapMinG.title: Smallest hit that flaps (g)
slapMinG.description: Typing makes ~0.03 g taps; hits below this are ignored.
